bm_desc: NESTLE INDIA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 22-Jul-2026 to inter-alia consider and approve the Unaudited Financial results of the Company for the Quarterly ended June 2026 .
NESTLE INDIA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 03-Jul-2026 to consider Dividend.

A meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled for Friday, 3rd July 2026, to consider declaration of a special dividend 2026, if any, out of the Retained Earnings of the Company.
